{{TOC|align=right}}

==Timeline==
''All times in UTC.'' 

* 2025-05-07 0220 [https://logstash.wikimedia.org/app/discover#/doc/logstash-*/logstash-mediawiki-1-7.0.0-1-2025.05.07?id=OJUeq5YBfOjk-Vo1yy77 The daily job which creates our autocomplete indices fails] (restricted link), causing a subset of English Wikipedia articles to disappear from autocomplete results.

*2025-05-07 1554  Bking (Search Platform SRE) merges [[gerrit:c/operations/puppet/+/1141903|this patch]] as a part of our ongoing [[phab:T388610|OpenSearch migration]]. As a result, the next day's daily job is cancelled and there is no opportunity for the job to fix the autocomplete results.
*2025-05-07 1832 User thesavagenorwegian [[phab:T393635|opens this Phab task]] to report the problem.
*2025-05-08 0825 - Dcausse (Search Platform software engineer) routes traffic away from EQIAD. User impact stops.

==Detection==
'''Issue first detected by:''' The community, see [[phab:T393663|this Phab task]].

'''Relevant alerts:''' Did not fire

==Conclusions ==

===What went well?===

* We (Search Platform) already had a plan to route traffic away from EQIAD, so it was easy to implement.

===What went poorly?===

* Several community members opened tickets, which suggests noticeable impact.

===Where did we get lucky?===

* We (Search Platform) already had a plan to route traffic away from EQIAD, so it was easy to implement.
